verdict.rationale: Supabase's own Database Webhooks let a user register outbound HTTP callbacks to any endpoint, fired on table INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE events, so a programmatic consumer can receive event payloads. However, the documented event scope covers only database table events, so the story's broader 'subscribe to events' is only partly covered. Missing for 10: webhook events beyond database table changes (e.g. auth, storage, platform/project events), documented delivery guarantees such as retries and payload signing, agent-facing (MCP/API) webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
You can hook into three table events: `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE`.
